verdict.rationale: There's clear evidence of a dedicated sandbox API endpoint (api.sandbox.namecheap.com) distinct from production, which supports safe testing without real charges, and third-party SDKs/Terraform providers exist for self-serve API usage. However, there's no documented self-serve process for obtaining sandbox credentials, no mention of sandbox account signup flow, and the sandbox endpoint evidence only shows error responses (missing parameter), not confirmation of full test-mode functionality. Missing for 10: self-serve sandbox account creation docs, confirmation that domain registration/renewal calls are free in sandbox, independent developer corroboration of the sandbox experience.
